tasks.title: Project provider schemas and validate canonical task results
tasks.objective: Implement tested exact provider/CLI schema projections without changing the canonical task-result schema; validate all decoded results against that canonical schema; bind provider, version and projection digest in run provenance; and allow Claude's existing OAuth session without weakening restricted execution.
